outfit.name: 晨雾私语缎面深V系带晨袍
outfit.prose: A lustrous pearl white mulberry silk dressing robe tied loosely with a wide sash, sliding slightly off one shoulder to reveal collarbones. As the draped hem parts, it exposes bare legs adorned with a single delicate pale blue velvet thigh ribbon that subtly presses into the pale skin, barefoot.
